# DETRAN phase closures (OE-01 of CMP-0004)

Byte-exact copy of the adopter repository `aarusso-nyx/detran` at commit
`897f01991a17e20253721ecf7c8592f2123a37f0`, supplied for ADR-EVI-0001 (#169).

- `record/proofs/compliance/closures/PC-0001.json` to `PC-0020.json`: twenty
  closures; PC-0018 supersedes PC-0017 (R-0017) and PC-0020 supersedes PC-0015
  (R-0018).
- `record/derived/indexes/rounds.md`: the index DETRAN's authorized local
  generator (`tools/devai/render-rounds-index.mjs`) rendered from them
  (DETRAN commit `5d254a18`). DETRAN sealed R-0017 against it with PC-0018.

No credential or absolute host path is present. Do not edit these files.
